'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Andrew Howard DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Howard]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
